gaps.sentence: It is the first time I ___ paella.
gaps.hint: it is the first time takes present perfect
gaps.explanation: After 'It is the first time', English uses the present perfect: have eaten.

gaps.sentence: When we were students, we ___ to live on instant noodles.
gaps.hint: a past habit with used to
gaps.explanation: 'Used to' plus the infinitive describes a past habit: used to live.

gaps.sentence: When she was a student, she ___ spend her summers hitchhiking around Europe.
gaps.hint: a repeated past action with would
gaps.explanation: 'Would' describes repeated past actions in narrative: would spend.

gaps.sentence: Our team ___ the championship twice in the last five years.
gaps.hint: in the last five years up to now
gaps.explanation: 'In the last five years' is a period up to the present, so the present perfect fits: has won.

gaps.sentence: He rarely ___ his laptop on Sundays because he prefers to rest.
gaps.explanation: Frequency adverbs such as 'rarely' mark habitual actions, which take the present simple: uses.

gaps.sentence: It was the first time she ___ a car on her own.
gaps.hint: it was the first time takes past perfect
gaps.explanation: After 'It was the first time' in past contexts, English uses the past perfect: had driven.

gaps.sentence: I ___ her at a conference in 2019, but we did not start working together until last year.
gaps.hint: in 2019 pins a finished past time
gaps.explanation: 'In 2019' is a finished past time, so the past simple is required: met.

gaps.sentence: Hush! The director ___ about the budget at the moment.
gaps.hint: at the moment shows active thinking process
gaps.explanation: Here 'think' describes a mental process in progress, not an opinion, so the continuous is used: is thinking.
